output.reason: Sender is the known customer Hansen Metallbau GmbH (C1001) and reference 4500012397 is stated. HM-2210 resolves via the customer-material records to TS-125-INOX (sold in packs of 25), so 10 x HM-2210 means 10 packs. The ERP rejected the order with 409: insufficient stock (requested 10 PAC, available 8). No order was created; the customer needs to be told that only 8 packs are available or the quantity must be confirmed.
uncertainties: Stock shortfall: the customer asked for 10 packs but only 8 are available in the ERP, so the order was rejected and no order exists.
Unit interpretation: the mail gives no unit, so 10 was read as 10 sales units (packs of 25 pieces), which is the sales unit the customer-material record names.
